faqs.a: Send an order request from your cart. We confirm the sizes, stock and final total by email within one business day, with a secure payment link. This website never asks for card details.

faqs.q: How do I know which size to order?
faqs.a: Each product page shows the manufacturer's sizing method. Our measuring guides show how to take the numbers. If you are unsure, add a note to your order request with your measurements and we will check them before you pay.
We do not bill insurance directly. On request we send an itemized receipt with billing codes, so you can submit a claim to your plan yourself. Ask your insurer about coverage before you order.
Most supports can be ordered without one. Some rigid braces are usually fitted after a prescription, and your insurer may require one for reimbursement. When in doubt, ask your clinician first.

faqs.q: Can I return an item that does not fit?
faqs.a: Yes, when it is unused and in its original packaging. If the size is wrong, contact us first. Most size problems can be solved with an exchange.
Many braces are made for the left or the right. Choose the side of your body that needs support. For a hand or wrist brace that means the hand you will wear it on.
A renewed item has been returned, checked, cleaned and tested by the supplier. It works like new and may show light cosmetic wear. It is priced below a new unit.
Yes. Clinics, therapists and care teams can ask for volume pricing through the Clinician Partner Program.
